startup_idea.biggest_risk_assumption: Founders may not provide enough specific context to produce actionable feedback.
startup_idea.differentiation: Combines structured rubric scoring, threaded community critique, and AI-assisted rewrites in one iterative workflow.
startup_idea.evidence_of_problem: Repeated founder discussions show teams struggle to define ICP and unique value before investing engineering time.
startup_idea.existing_alternatives: Founder forums, random social feedback, and generic survey tools give fragmented and unstructured validation input.
startup_idea.problem: Early-stage founders often waste months building before validating core assumptions about audience, value proposition, and monetization.
startup_idea.solution: A platform where founders publish structured idea briefs and receive scored community plus AI feedback on clarity, ICP fit, monetization, risks, and differentiation.
startup_idea.target_audience: First-time and indie founders validating B2B or prosumer startup ideas.

title: Platform to validate startup ideas with structured feedback
body_md: I want to build a platform where founders can post startup ideas and receive structured feedback on clarity, target audience, monetization, and risks before building. The goal is to reduce wasted time on weak ideas and help founders sharpen positioning through community and AI-assisted review.
